headline: How to Stop People Cheating Your Punch Card
description: Paper stamps are easy to copy. Here's how small shops stop fake punches, screenshot scans and double-dipping, with a simple checklist that doesn't punish regulars.

mainEntity.name: Is punch card fraud actually common?

acceptedAnswer.text: There's no good public data on how often it happens in small shops, so be wary of anyone quoting a number. People do openly share ways to fake stamps online, which is reason enough to close the easy gaps.

mainEntity.name: Should I confront someone I think is cheating?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keep it calm and about the rule, not the person: "We can only add one punch per visit."

mainEntity.name: Will these rules put off honest customers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not if they're invisible. A regular should never notice the time limit or the changing QR code. They just get their punch.
